headlines.title: PepsiCo Q3 2026 earnings: profit outlook cut, cost reductions planned
headlines.summary: The company says it will identify cuts "with a high sense of urgency," shifting resources away from areas not contributing to growth

headlines.title: PepsiCo Is Raising €1 Billion a Day After Cutting Profit Outlook
headlines.summary: PepsiCo Inc. entered Europe’s public bond market on Friday with a €1 billion ($1.12 billion) two-part deal, a day after cutting its profit outlook on mounting costs in North America.

headlines.title: PEP Q3 Deep Dive: International Growth Offsets North American Beverage Weakness, Margin Pressures Persist
headlines.summary: Food and beverage company PepsiCo (NASDAQ:PEP) reported Q3 2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 5.6% year on year to $25.27 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.34 per share was 1.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: PepsiCo (PEP) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
headlines.summary: Input costs and mix headwinds force PepsiCo to cut full-year earnings guidance.

headlines.title: PEP Stock Looks To Snap 6-Week Losing Streak: Goldman Sachs Trims Price Target But Sees ‘Decade Of Growth’ For PepsiCo
headlines.summary: PepsiCo faces near-term margin pressures from rising costs and beverage challenges, but Goldman Sachs maintains a ‘Buy’ rating.

description: PepsiCo, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of various beverages and convenient foods worldwide. The company operates through six segments: PepsiCo Foods North America; PepsiCo Beverages North America; International Beverages Franchise; Europe, Middle East and Africa; Latin America Foods; and Asia Pacific Foods. It offers cereals, chips, dips, granola bars, oatmeal, pasta, rice, and syrups and mixes; refrigerated dips and spreads; beverage concentrates, fountain syrups, and finished goods; and ready-to-drink tea and coffee products. The company also provides SodaStream sparkling water makers and related products, as well as various dairy products under the Agusha, Chudo, and Domik v Derevne brands. It serves wholesale and other distributors, foodservice customers, grocery stores, drug stores, convenience stores, discount/dollar stores, mass merchandisers, membership stores, hard discounters, e-commerce retailers and authorized independent bottlers, and others through a network of direct-store-delivery, customer warehouse, and distributor networks, as well as directly to consumers through e-commerce platforms and retailers. PepsiCo, Inc. was founded in 1898 and is based in Purchase, New York.
